tool.title: Web app build
tool.description: Build every declared `web-app` directory in the checkout and publish each at its own route, `<locale>/<harness>/apps/<id>/`, with no site chrome (every page marked `folio-navbar: none`), plus an `apps/` index in the site's chrome listing each app with its languages and size. Before building, each locale's translated UI strings are written from the layer's `translations/<locale>/apps/<id>.po` to the app's `i18n.out`, so building is the injection. `--extract` writes the translation templates; `--check` validates the declarations and translations and builds nothing.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Validate every declaration (manifest, build script, lockfile, route clashes) and translation (templates current, placeholders kept, no stale entries); build nothing.

inputs.name: extract
inputs.description: Write each app's translation templates, `translations/<locale>/apps/<id>.pot`, in the declaring layer: the app's "refresh the templates" step of the translation process.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A site being built: write the apps and the index at their declared route under it instead of under the harness's own site directory.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: Each app's build under `<locale>/<harness>/apps/<id>/`, and the index page at `<locale>/<harness>/apps/`.

selection.when: A site build of a checkout in which any layer declares a `web-app` directory; run with the other declared writers (`visualiser-writers.ts`). `--extract` whenever an app's catalog changes, as the translation watcher's template step; `--check` in the declaring layer's PR checks.
selection.limits: Builds with npm or bun from the app's lockfile, so it needs the npm registry. An app's pages are its own: the Tool marks them chrome-less and does not otherwise change them. Untranslated strings fall back to the source text in the app.
selection.cost: One install and one build per app; seconds to a minute each.

remedies.none: Without the registry an app cannot install; the index names it as not built rather than listing it as published.

$comment.comment: Owner, 2026-11-11 (cards Q-GAME-5 A, Q-GAME-7 A): apps a content layer carries are published by the harness, so the layer need not be a harness; the VaxLink one-off publish route is retired. Implementation: cat-harness-tools scripts/gen-web-apps.ts and scripts/web-app-strings.ts.
